name: pc-filebridge
description: Read files and create new files on explicitly allowed PC folders without overwrite or delete capabilities.

interface.shortDescription: Read files and create new ones without overwrite or delete.
interface.longDescription: Create-only filesystem bridge for ChatGPT, Codex, and compatible MCP clients. Access is limited to operator-configured roots; reads are bounded and writes use exclusive create mode. No delete, rename, move, append, patch, or overwrite tools are exposed.
defaultPrompt: Show the folders available through PC FileBridge.
Read a file from my allowed Documents root.
Create a new file without replacing anything.
